scripts.build:packages: rm -rf dist && cd ../../packages && rm -rf dist && bun run build && cd ../examples/ssr
scripts.build:css: bunx postcss "src/{,**/}*.css" "!src/**/tailwind.css" --dir dist --minify && bunx @tailwindcss/cli --input src/tailwind.css --output src/.tailwindcss.txt --minify
scripts.dev: bun run build:packages && bun run build:css && bun build src/{,**}/*.ts --outdir dist --hot --entry-naming [name].[ext] && rm -f dist/*.d.js && bun run --hot app.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:css && bun build src/{,**}/*.ts --outdir dist --splitting --minify --entry-naming [hash].[ext] --chunk-naming [hash].[ext] && rm -f dist/*.d.js && bun run --minify app.ts
